verdict.rationale: Resend documents an official CLI (resend-cli GitHub repo, referenced across docs for domain verification, segment renaming, API interactions) and explicitly instructs users to 'Install and use the Resend CLI from the terminal,' which directly satisfies the AI-native/agentic CLI story. missing for 10: independent hands-on review of the CLI itself and more detail on its command surface/coverage relative to the full API.
